case.name: Andermatt cadastral DH routing benchmark
case.boundary_rule: axis-aligned bounding box of all operator-owned observed house-transfer points, expanded by 250 m; local inlet fixed at the northern mapped feed crossing
case.thermal_input_basis: uniform scenario load; no measured customer heat demands are available
case.source_basis: mapped incoming trunk crossing the northern boundary; supplied as a local distribution inlet to both tools; upstream Göschenen plant and Bergleitung excluded
case.benchmark_scope: conditional local-distribution route reconstruction with observed transfer and inlet coordinates supplied to both tools
case.reference_route_use: held out from construction except the explicitly supplied inlet and consumer locations
case.original_table_xii_case: 85 current cadastral transfer points; not a reproduction of the earlier 50-transfer-station sample
case.reference_quality: mapped active corridors; physical connectivity is inferred from 2D geometry, and the public consumer point layer is not assumed exhaustive

urban4.objective_interpretation: annual heat prize divided by newly added trench plus service length; non-monetary

candidate_graph_reduction: non-terminal leaf pruning and degree-2 contraction; alternate parallel corridors retained
shared_inputs: same OSM road corridors and service attachments
reference_route_leakage: Only the declared inlet location is read from the reference route; no installed edge guides routing
metadata_note: Boundary wording clarified after execution; numeric bounds, ports, customer set, loads and graphs unchanged.
